name: Ricardo Oliveira
bio:
Ricardo's journey into motorsport began unconventionally. After a successful career in statistical analysis for the banking sector, he felt a pull towards a more dynamic field. A lifelong passion for Formula 1, coupled with a desire to apply his analytical skills to a high-stakes environment, led him to pursue a career in motorsport. He started by volunteering his time with a local racing team, rapidly proving his ability to extract actionable insights from complex data sets.

Ricardo's approach as a data analyst is deeply rooted in pragmatism. He believes in focusing on the data that truly matters, avoiding the trap of over-analysis. His experience in the finance world instilled in him a meticulous attention to detail and a strong understanding of risk assessment. He's known for his ability to translate complex statistical findings into clear, concise recommendations that drivers and engineers can readily understand. His distinctive trait is his ability to see patterns and connections that others often miss, making him an invaluable asset to Cavaleiro Sports.

He thrives on identifying marginal gains and optimizing performance through data-driven insights. Ricardo's commitment to excellence and his ability to maintain a level-headed perspective under pressure make him an indispensable member of the team. He firmly believes that data, when properly analyzed and applied, can be the decisive factor that separates victory from defeat.
